title.en: A giant black hole on a very short cosmic clock
title.zh: 巨型黑洞与宇宙早年的短时钟

summary.en: Euclid’s November 24 quasar discovery reaches an epoch about 630 million years after the Big Bang. An estimated 360-million-solar-mass black hole and comparatively slow observed feeding sharpen the question of its earlier growth.
summary.zh: 欧几里得望远镜11月24日公布的类星体发现，将视线推至大爆炸后约6.3亿年。约3.6亿太阳质量的黑洞与当时较慢的进食速度，使早期成长之谜更为紧迫。
